elements.name: Armoured entrance
elements.about: Two checks and a blast door; only cleared staff enter.

elements.name: Issue room
elements.about: Munitions are signed out here for each cruiser and loaded on armoured carts.

elements.name: Inspection bay
elements.about: Every shell and missile is checked before it goes aboard.

elements.name: Magazine control room
elements.about: Watches temperature, smoke and doors in every vault.

elements.name: Suppression plant room
elements.about: Water deluge and gas systems that drown a vault in seconds.
